puzzles.title: Say Hello
puzzles.story: The terminal flickers to life. Greet the world to power it on.
puzzles.task: Write a print statement that greets the world.
hints: Look at the goal output. Which word comes after 'Hello, '?
It starts with a capital W and it is the thing we are greeting.

puzzles.title: Bonus Points
puzzles.story: Your score needs a bonus to reach the next rank.
puzzles.task: Set a bonus, add it to the score, and print 15.
puzzles.template:
score = 10
bonus = ___
total = score + bonus
print(total)
hints: The program should print 15.
score is 10, so what must bonus be to make 15?

puzzles.title: Loop It
puzzles.story: The door only opens after the code is chanted three times.
puzzles.task: Use a for loop to print Code! three times.
hints: range(n) repeats the indented lines n times.
The goal shows the word printed 3 times.

puzzles.title: Even or Odd
puzzles.story: The bridge guard only lets even numbers across.
puzzles.task: Use the modulo operator to check whether 8 is even.
hints: You need the operator that gives the remainder of a division.
It is the percent sign. 8 % 2 is 0, so 8 is even.

puzzles.title: Countdown
puzzles.story: Launch sequence! Count down, but stop before zero.
puzzles.task: Use a while loop to count down from 3, then print Liftoff!
puzzles.template:
count = 3
while count ___ 0:
    print(count)
    count = count - 1
print("Liftoff!")
hints: The loop should keep going while count is bigger than 0.
Use > (greater than). >= would also print 0.

puzzles.title: Add It Up
puzzles.story: Add the numbers 1 to 5 to unlock the vault.
puzzles.task: Use a for loop to add each number from 1 through 5 to total, then print it.
puzzles.template:
total = 0
for n in range(1, ___):
    total = total + ___
print(total)
hints: range(1, 6) gives 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. The end number is not included.
Inside the loop, add the loop variable n to total.
puzzles.solutionFeedback: That prints 15, but adds 5 three times. range stops before its end value, so include 6 and add n on each pass.

puzzles.title: Market Math
puzzles.story: The market's price scanner needs a quick multiplication check.
puzzles.task: Multiply the price by the quantity and print the total.
hints: The quantity is stored in the variable named quantity.
Multiply 4 by 3 to get 12.

puzzles.title: Weather Station
puzzles.story: The station marks readings below 20 as cool.
puzzles.task: Use a comparison to print cool for a temperature of 18.
hints: The warm branch should only run for a temperature of at least 20.
Use >= so 18 takes the cool branch.

puzzles.title: Long Addition
puzzles.story: The archive counts every number from 1 through 10.
puzzles.task: Use a loop to add all numbers from 1 through 10.
puzzles.template:
total = 0
for n in range(1, ___):
    total += n
print(total)
hints: range stops before its second number.
Use 11 as the stopping value to include 10.

puzzles.title: Nested Signal
puzzles.story: Two signal rows each need three pulses to activate the beacon.
puzzles.task: Nest one loop inside another to print six pulses.
hints: The inner loop prints three times for every outer loop pass.
Run the outer loop twice to print six pulses.
puzzles.expectedOutput:
Pulse
Pulse
Pulse
Pulse
Pulse
Pulse
